overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short AAOI Daily ETF (AAOZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides inverse (-2x) exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. (NASDAQ: AAOI) stock. AAOZ was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
